findings.message: Client admission topology drift publishes the wrong public result. After an accepted map creates the replica collaborators, a false final-Ack send followed by world/scope drift reaches ValidateScope from SendFinalAck and faults Topology while leaving Result null. The frozen terminal mapping requires Result=ChunkMapRejected for every client topology failure during admission. Make this validation phase-aware and change SessionTests.cs:331, which currently asserts the non-conformant null result.

The new private fields _clientSchema and _clientHello are assigned in ProcessClientHello but never read, producing CS0414 warnings. Either use the stored values for admission evaluation or remove the unused storage.

Passing new NoOpTransform() to an IPayloadTransform parameter boxes the readonly struct on every control encode; Session.cs repeats the same boxing on every decode. Cache one stateless IPayloadTransform instance or add a non-boxing path.
Add accepted and rejected pair-pump tests using production MemoryTransport capacity one, including client consumption and disposal before the rejecting server observes RemoteClosed.

Add transports that transfer then throw, assign inbound ownership then throw, and throw from outbound after valid inbound progression; prove cleanup, consumed step index, committed receive state and byte-identical retry.
Complete the phase-semantic mutation matrix and exercise the Session-level exhaustion branch through a sanctioned deterministic internal seam without reflection.

Correct the rejection barrier order: server enters Closing after enqueue; client consumes and disposes; server then steps RemoteClosed and publishes rejection. Warn against early rejecting-server disposal.

validation: The range contains exactly one commit and the candidate worktree is clean; git diff --check passes.
All nine changed paths match ownership and all four new metadata GUIDs are unique.
No forbidden paths, Sample, SessionWorld, Main alias or gameplay transfer calls were introduced.
Public enum values, names, signatures and XML summaries match the contract.
Pre-decode bounds, four-packet handshake, sequences, epochs, retry, rejection barrier, Requested echo and lease cleanup are structurally present.
A focused compiler probe confirmed assigned-but-unread private fields produce CS0414.
Production MemoryTransport, stronger throwing transports, the full semantic matrix and Session-level exhaustion remain repair validation.
